review_type: read-only cross-host provenance and corrective-design review

review_findings.chronology: Prior PACS V1 and transfer outcomes predate this v3 seal and are fully disclosed.
review_findings.scientific_alignment: The alpha, confidence budgets, Lambda, M, primary budget, denominators, selectors, H/S/B tails, and decision gates are carried forward from v2.
review_findings.seed_contract: The exact unexecuted v2 training and audit seed manifests are carried forward byte-for-byte to avoid a provenance-driven scientific redesign.
review_findings.independence_boundary: Fresh RNG and checkpoints do not create an untouched dataset, an independent source population, or external validation.
review_findings.implementation: A clean Ubuntu source snapshot, dedicated image, mount isolation, and PACS-free synthetic integration are still required.
review_findings.negative_result_rule: Every adverse v3 cell remains in the registered denominator and must be released.
